summary: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp., a BVI-domiciled Nasdaq-listed blank-check company (ARCLU/ARCL/ARCLR/ARCLW), filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing a share purchase agreement to acquire all outstanding ordinary shares of Firstborn Top Capital Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian private limited company, from its selling shareholders. This is a de-SPAC business combination; post-closing, Firstborn holders become ARC securityholders and Datuk Dr. Doris Wong serves as purchaser shareholder representative. The excerpt omits price, premium, outside date and breakup fee. Watch for the proxy/extension timeline, redemptions and Nasdaq listing mechanics.
